rationale: Block 7 describes Ortolani and Barlow manoeuvres — a classic trap is calling the Ortolani sign a 'click' when it is a 'clunk' (palpable/audible reduction); this TrueFalse directly targets that misconception.

Block 9 covers age-based imaging in DDH — the key trap is that ultrasound (Graf method) is the investigation of choice below 6 months, while X-ray is unreliable before the femoral head ossifies (~4–6 months).

Block 13 covers the Ponseti method — the critical trap is the ORDER of correction (CAVE mnemonic: Cavus, Adductus, Varus, Equinus). Equinus must be corrected LAST; premature equinus correction creates a rocker-bottom deformity.
Block 4 covers Cobb angle measurement and curve grading — a common exam trap is the threshold for 'scoliosis' vs normal spinal asymmetry (≥10°) and the surgical threshold (≥40–45°).
